display_long_description:
This application is meant for Schools, Colleges and Industries. It is not meant for individual purposes.

Please download "Skillveri Aura MR lite welding simulator" for individual usages. 

Weld on real world objects, see it inside your virtual world !
Skillveri AURA MR welding simulator now blends the best of both worlds in mixed reality mode. 

Skillveri Welding simulator now brings the VR experience blended into the actual real world environment of the user. 
Real welding guns sold separately by Skillveri can be used with this version of the software. Our VR welding simulators offer 
4 types of welding (GMAW, GTAW, SMAW, FCAW)
Choice of different metal types & thickness
All welding positions
Level based lesson sequence from easy to difficult - unlock as your progress !
Live feedback 
Detailed scorecard after each lesson
Progress tracking and reports 

Trusted by Industry leaders across the world, and used by 50+ schools & community colleges across North America for their CTE programs. Learn more at www.skillveri.com

Experience the Skillveri difference with a free trial licence.  
Note : Request a trial license by filling the form at https://skillveri.com/skillveri-metaverse-workshop-trial-request-form/
